summary: Implemented Merkle-tree based anti-entropy state synchronization in gossipmesh/p2p/merkle.py and gossipmesh/p2p/entropy.py, along with comprehensive unit tests in tests/test_merkle_entropy.py. All functions adhere to strict limits (<60 LOC), maintain high throughput, zero-allocation/data-race safety principles, and integrate smoothly with the gossip transport layer.
